Screenshot description (via vision model):
This is a screenshot of a Tetris web app interface with a dark navy blue background.  

### Layout  
- **Left side**: A large vertical rectangle with a glowing cyan border (game board area), filled with black (no game pieces).  
- **Right side**: A vertical column of UI elements.  

### Visible Text  
- Top: “TETRIS” in large, bold, pink text.  
- Below “TETRIS”:  
  - “SCORE” in light blue text.  
  - “0” in pink text (under “SCORE”).  
- Below score:  
  - “NEXT PIECE” in light blue text.  
  - A smaller dark gray square with a glowing cyan border (next piece preview area), filled with black.  
- Below next piece:  
  - “CONTROLS” in light blue text.  
  - Six control buttons (2 rows, 3 columns) with labels and symbols:  
    - Top row (left to right): “Left” with a pink left arrow above; “Right” with a pink right arrow above; “Down” with a pink down arrow above.  
    - Bottom row (left to right): “Rotate” with a pink up arrow above; “Space Drop” (text: “Space” in pink, “Drop” in white) with a pink down arrow above; “Pause” with a pink “P” symbol above.  
- Below controls: Two horizontal buttons:  
  - “Start Game” (white text on a purple gradient button).  
  - “Pause” (white text on a purple gradient button, directly below “Start Game”).  

### Colors  
- Background: Dark navy blue.  
- Borders: Glowing cyan (game board, next piece preview).  
- Text: Pink (score “0”, control arrow symbols, “Space” in “Space Drop”, “P” for pause), light blue (section headers: “SCORE”, “NEXT PIECE”, “CONTROLS”), white (text on “Left”, “Right”, etc., and on control buttons).  
- Buttons: Purple gradient (for “Start Game” and “Pause” buttons).  

### Broken/Blank/Overlapping/Unstyled Elements  
- The game board (left side) and next piece preview (center-right) are blank (intentional, as the game is not started).  
- No elements overlap; all text and UI components are clearly placed.  
- Text and symbols are styled consistently (e.g., control arrows match button labels).

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Classic Tetris</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e, #16213e);
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            color: #fff;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        .game-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 25px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }
        
        .game-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        
        .game-header h1 {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            color: #ff6b6b;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.7);
        }
        
        .game-board {
            position: relative;
        }
        
        canvas {
            background-color: #0f0f1a;
            border: 3px solid #4cc9f0;
            border-radius: 5px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3);
        }
        
        .side-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
            min-width: 150px;
        }
        
        .panel-section {
            background: rgba(30, 30, 50, 0.8);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        
        .panel-title {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            color: #4cc9f0;
        }
        
        .score-display {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #f72585;
        }
        
        .next-piece {
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        
        .controls {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }
        
        .control-key {
            background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.2);
            border: 1px solid #4cc9f0;
            border-radius: 5px;
            padding: 8px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        
        .control-key span {
            display: block;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #f72585;
        }
        
        .game-buttons {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }
        
        button {
            background: linear-gradient(to right, #4361ee, #3a0ca3);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        
        button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.4);
        }
        
        .game-over {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            display: none;
        }
        
        .game-over h2 {
            color: #ff6b6b;
            font-size: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        
        .instructions {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            li

transcript.summary:
I have successfully created a complete, self-contained Tetris game in a single HTML file named tetris.html. The game includes all requested features:

- A visible playing field (10x20 grid)
- All seven standard Tetromino pieces (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z) with distinct colors
- Full rotation functionality
- Left and right movement controls
- Gravity-based piece dropping
- Line clearing mechanics
- Score display that updates as lines are cleared
- Next piece preview
- Game controls (Start, Pause/Resume, Restart)
- Game over detection
- Increasing difficulty (speed increases as score grows)

The game has a modern, visually appealing design with:
- Dark theme with gradient background
- Glowing cyan borders on game elements
- Colorful tetromino pieces with 3D effect
- Responsive layout that works on different screen sizes
- Clear control instructions
- Score tracking and game state management

The implementation is fully self-contained in a single HTML file with no external dependencies, CDN links, or network access required.
